publishedWorks.title: Forecasting Child Immunization Coverage and Predicting Underperformance Risk Using a Hybrid Time-Series Framework: Evidence from FHSIS Data
publishedWorks.publication: Accepted by IDAP (International Data & Analytics Proceedings)
publishedWorks.summary: Fully Immunized Child (FIC) coverage among children in the Philippines is an essential public health indicator, but the routinely utilized health information systems in the Philippines do not have prospective forecasting capabilities to inform public health decision-making. This paper introduces a temporally evaluated adaptive framework for forecasting and underperformance risk prediction of FIC coverage using quarterly Field Health Services Information System (FHSIS) data from Surigao del Norte, Philippines. Historical data (2021-2024) was used for expanding window cross-validation model selection, with 2025 held out for temporal evaluation. Models evaluated include ARIMA, Holt-Winters, Prophet, Moving Average, Naïve, Seasonal Naïve, Annual Profile, and Random Forest classifier (sensitivity = 1.0000, ROC-AUC = 0.9753).

publishedWorks.title: A Hybrid Time-Series Forecasting and Underperformance Risk Prediction System for Child Immunization Coverage in Surigao del Norte, Philippines: Evidence from FHSIS Quarterly Data
publishedWorks.summary: Approved for Scopus publication, with final publication date and DOI pending. The study prospectively validates a governed hybrid pipeline that selects among ARIMA, Holt-Winters ETS, and Prophet for LGU-level FIC and CIC forecasting, then identifies municipalities at risk of missing the 95% coverage target.
